James Gunn Confirms No Batman Casting Yet; 2028 Live‑Action Film Rumors Remain Unverified

01 Nov 2026, 10:59 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Editorial Desk · Source: www.comingsoon.net

3 min read

Key takeaways> “No one is in the running. We haven’t started casting yet.”

Confirmed Update from James Gunn

James Gunn, the co‑head of the DC Universe (DCU) film slate, recently addressed fan speculation about the next actor to portray Batman. In a response on the social platform Threads, Gunn stated:

“No one is in the running. We haven’t started casting yet.”

This comment confirms that no casting process has begun for the DCU’s Batman and that no actors have been shortlisted. Gunn also noted that the character appeared briefly—non‑speaking—in the animated series *Creature Commandos* and will have a more prominent cameo in the upcoming animated series *Batman: Brave and the Bold*. Both appearances are part of the DCU’s broader strategy to re‑introduce the Dark Knight before a live‑action rollout.

What Is Not Yet Confirmed

While Gunn’s remarks are clear, several other claims circulating online lack verification:

  • A live‑action Batman film slated for February 18, 2028 – The source mentions a sequel to Matt Reeves’ *The Batman* scheduled for 2028, but no official announcement from Warner Bros. or DC Studios has been made.
  • Casting details for the 2028 sequel – Names such as Sebastian Stan, Charles Dance, Scarlett Johansson, and Brian Tyree Henry are cited as attached to undisclosed roles, with speculation that Stan could play Harvey Dent. These reports have not been confirmed by the studio or the actors.
  • Plot specifics – The article describes a storyline set weeks after the flooding of Gotham and ties to the *Penguin* TV series. No plot details have been released by the filmmakers.

All of the above points should be treated as rumors or reported but unverified information.

Practical Implications for Fans

  • Casting timeline – Since Gunn has explicitly said casting has not started, fans should not expect official casting announcements until the DCU signals the start of the process, likely through a formal press release or a major industry event.
  • Verification – To confirm any future developments, monitor official channels:
  • Warner Bros. Discovery press releases
  • DC Studios’ verified social media accounts
  • Reputable entertainment news outlets (e.g., *Variety*, *The Hollywood Reporter*, *Deadline*)
  • Avoid speculation – Until the studio provides concrete details, treat any name‑dropping or plot leaks as speculative.
